outcome: Median morphine milligram equivalents per hospital stay
Median morphine milligram equivalents per day
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery at a single tertiary care center before and after a quality improvement intervention for pain management
finding: A multimodal stepwise approach to postcesarean delivery pain control significantly reduced opioid consumption without increasing hospital stay or worsening pain scores.
